mapper.insert: insert into orders (order_id, user_id, business_id, goods_id, goods_name, goods_img, goods_unit, goods_price, quantity, total_price, status, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{businessId}, #{goodsId}, #{goodsName}, #{goodsImg}, #{goodsUnit}, #{goodsPrice}, #{quantity}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update orders set status = #{toStatus}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = #{fromStatus}
